label: PUBLIC_DATA_TEMPORAL_P3
training_rule: all common admissible months before2005, including incomplete calendar years; at least6 distinct years and at least4 distinct training years per calendar month, so inner LOYO retains>=3 references; no score-based station exclusion
test_rule: retain every common admissible month in fixed2005-2014; station with>=1valid month and eligible training participates; full120months primary complete-window cohort, partial stations retained separately and in all-supported descriptive summary; no score-based year/site deletion

quality.Q: finite nonnegative qobs not-999, ckhs=1, unique full native calendar daily coverage; qceq/qcol diagnostics retained
quality.P: finite nonnegative dailyprec not-999, complete calendar month sum mm
quality.T: finite daily2m_temp_mean not-999, complete calendar month mean degC
quality.L1: actual preceding calendar month P; may be unlabeled exogenous month; missing never zero

formula: same P2 fixed train twelve monthly Qmeans + jointly Ridge-penalized P/T [and L1] standardized anomalies; no Snow, no feature/window changes
inner_validation: training-period only LOYO, mean of per-year MSE, one-SE largest alpha; partial inner held years allowed, observed month counts recorded
transform: training target rows only monthly means and sample std; inner refit; no test-period Q in fit/transform/tuning
constant_rule: unchanged P2: sd<=1e-12*max(1,maxabs)->zero standardized anomaly and support reason; raw zero retained, missing never zero
prediction_commit: all stations and both models predicted first, write separate immutable prediction bundle WITHOUT Qobs and seal SHA256; only then load test labels in scoring function
scoring: same exact months/labels for bothmodels; raw primary, max(raw,0) secondary; NSE KGE/components RMSE MAE MSE PBIAS; NA and reason for undefined; annual MSE skill and equally weighted annual MSE

diagnostics.flows: low<=outer train Q20 and high>=outer train Q80, diagnostics only
diagnostics.uncertainty: year-paired fixed-loss bootstrap999 and jackknife perstation; macro river cluster bootstrap999 descriptive with only3unequal groups; do not pool raw m3/s squared losses across basins
diagnostics.extrapolation: test monthly anomalies vs frozen train month ranges/std, constant departures; target month mean drift scored postcommit only

claims: independent later-period validation of already developed methods on same27basins; not new basin test, not advance-month forecasting, not physical loss attribution; once used for P4 selection not a fresh final P4 test
